security.authentication: Bearer token for execution and nonpublic results
security.credentials: Never commit tokens or third-party racing API keys
security.execution: Explicit authorization required for workflow dispatch

POST /v1/runs.notes: Future API only; cannot execute until authenticated dispatch bridge is deployed.

GET /v1/runs/{run_id}/predictions.notes: Return HTTP 409 until run completed; never return fabricated empty results as completed.

constraints: V6 frozen artifacts must never be modified.
V7 is research-only until walk-forward validation and approval.
Never claim a model run completed if only discovery ran.
Return data provenance, timestamps, scratchings/coverage caveats.
Enforce per-client authorization, rate limits, idempotency, and run audit logging before deployment.
